pcs.pc_description: work safely at all times, complying with health and safety legislation, regulations and other relevant guidelines.
maintain correct body posture while seating in an allocated work space for long hours.
select and use appropriate personal protective equipment compatible to the work and compliant to relevant occupational health and safety guidelines.
lift, carry or move heavy objects from one place to another using approved safe working practices.
follow electrical safety measures while handling electrically powered tools.
ensure that the work area is free of clutters and the environment favorable to carry out metal cutting work.

modules.module_title: Prepare work area for metal cutting

pcs.pc_description: obtain job specification document or instructions from responsible personnel.
confirm that the given information or instructions are complete and correct.
interpret job requirements accurately and plan out sequence of work in accordance with job specifications.
obtain appropriate tools, materials and accessories suitable for the required work.
confirm that the selected tools and accessories are in safe working condition and ready for use.
use approved procedures to inspect metal sheet visually for any possible defects as per required standard parameters prior to work.

modules.module_title: Use approved procedures to cut metal sheets

pcs.pc_description: mark out the required shape using approved measuring methods & tools (auzars).
apply appropriate cutting techniques to cut out the pieces.
check that rough edges are trimmed as per the required quality standards.
ensure that each finished piece complies with operational requirements.

modules.module_title: Carry out post metal cutting activities

pcs.pc_description: collect and store metal scraps in designated storage locations.
return all the used tools and materials safely to appropriate storage area.
report any work related problems or issues to responsible authority and seek guidance on how to efficiently resolve them.
segregate and dispose toxic and non-toxic materials in line with environmental health & safety.
document the work fully and accurately in appropriate service log book/ record book detailing the required information.
follow organizations policies while handing over completed work to appropriate personnel or department.
